sections.skill: Disclose sponsorships and affiliate links clearly

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: What is a material connection?

choices.text: A friendship with no money or gifts involved at all
The material a product is made from
A payment, free product or commission tied to the promotion

questions.correct_answer: A payment, free product or commission tied to the promotion
questions.intro: If someone promoting a product has a MATERIAL CONNECTION to the business (they were paid, given free products, or earn a commission), that connection should be DISCLOSED clearly. An AFFILIATE LINK pays the promoter a commission when someone buys. Clear disclosures are short, plain and placed where people will see them before clicking or buying, such as "Ad," "Sponsored," or "I earn a commission if you buy." A platform's built-in disclosure tool is not automatically enough. Businesses should tell the people promoting them to disclose.

sections.skill: A friend who earns money from the recommendation

questions.domain: Foundation 11: Marketing, sales and social media
questions.prompt: Why might you feel misled?

choices.text: You did not know she was paid
The phone she chose was free

questions.correct_answer: You did not know she was paid
questions.intro: If a friend recommends a phone and you later learn the store paid her for every phone she helped sell, you might feel misled. It does not mean the phone is bad; you just would have wanted to know. Disclosures tell people about the connection up front, so they can decide how much weight to give the recommendation.
